gap_summary: The declared state requires a complete readiness evidence packet before the release is treated as launch-ready, but the observed state shows the release was marked ready while regression test results, technical reviewer approval, and monitoring confirmation were missing from the reviewed packet.
missing_evidence: Completed regression test result record linked to release candidate 2026.06.22.

confidence.basis: The readiness requirement and reviewed evidence packet support an evidence gap, but missing records may exist outside the reviewed packet.

recommended_next_action.description: Do not treat launch readiness as settled until the missing regression, technical approval, monitoring, and risk-review records are collected or an approved exception is documented.

limitations: The missing evidence may exist in systems outside the reviewed evidence packet.
